_comment: Canonical example for ~/.agentworks/awos-local.profile.json. Copy to that path, edit, and the daemon will pick it up on next restart. Loader precedence: AGENTWORKS_LOCAL_PROFILE env path -> this file -> bridged defaults from ~/.agentworks/awos-local.env.
_comment_repoRoot: Absolute path to the agentworks-os checkout.
_comment_dataDir: Directory holding agentworks.db plus WAL/SHM sidecars. Must match AGENTOS_DATA_DIR in awos-local.env to avoid dbPath-mismatch drift.
_comment_dbPath: Verified live DB path. Trust endpoint compares this to the daemon-opened path.
_comment_vaultRoot: FileVaultStore root. Trust endpoint reports drift if this path is missing.
_comment_tenantId: Example local tenant. Companies enumerated below all belong to this tenant.
_comment_expectedCompanies: Names from execution_companies WHERE tenant_id = tenantId, ordered by name. Trust endpoint surfaces missing-expected-company if any are absent.
_comment_alwaysKeepIssueIds: Issue-preview classifier never marks these as cleanup candidates regardless of heartbeat or queue state.
_comment_ports: admin = Next.js admin-ui (LaunchAgent com.agentworks.admin-ui-watchdog). api = agentos-d daemon (AGENTOS_PORT in env file is 7710 today).
_comment_launchdLabels: Doctor checks these labels with launchctl print. Add new daemons here when introduced.
_comment_backupDir: awos-snapshot.mjs writes <ts>.db + <ts>.json + <ts>.manifest.json triplets here. Operator creates the directory; sprint does not.
_comment_allowedFallbackModel: Bridge fails closed unless FALLBACK_MODEL matches this.
_comment_lastKnownGoodSnapshot: Optional. Filename (not full path) of the most recent snapshot validated by awos-restore-plan. Restore-plan refuses to suggest snapshots older than this without --force.
